filterGuide.title: Tell the system which data to understand?
filterGuide.lead: You just connected a new data source. Before anything enters the knowledge base, EverRoom's filter judges each item — "is this worth keeping?" — and your preference tells it directly: what content should be understood, and what can be ignored.
filterGuide.leadExample: Preferences are injected into every filter decision (highest priority). Writing them clearly greatly reduces false blocks and misses; skipping is fine too — the filter falls back to generic rules and learns your taste over time.
filterGuide.exampleTitle: Example (feel free to follow this format)
filterGuide.example:
Understand (keep):
- Decisions, tasks and project discussions in work email — even short ones
- Project context attached to calendar events
- Anything with concrete facts, numbers or conclusions

Ignore (filter out):
- Marketing, promotions, newsletter templates
- Pure notifications (delivered receipts, auto-replies, verification codes)
- Order confirmations, shipping updates
filterGuide.editTitle: Your filter preference (saved merged with the current one)
filterGuide.placeholder: Write what the system should and should not understand…

agentChat.SLIDES_CONFIRM_CONTENT: Content is right — choose a style
agentChat.SLIDES_CONFIRM_CONTENT_DISPLAY: Content is right — choose a style
agentChat.SLIDES_CONFIRM_CONTENT_LABEL: Confirm the content of "{{title}}" and choose a style
agentChat.SLIDES_CONFIRM_CONTENT_PROMPT: Use slides_draft(task=style, draftDocumentId="{{documentId}}") to start the style stage for "{{title}}" (generate style samples for me to pick). Treat the content I confirmed in the draft as authoritative.
agentChat.SLIDES_CONTINUE_EDIT_PROMPT: Open the deck "{{title}}" (fileEntryId="{{fileEntryId}}"); I'll tell you what to change next.
agentChat.SLIDES_CONTINUE_REMAINING_PROM: Use slides_draft(task=generate, draftDocumentId="{{documentId}}") to continue generating the pages that weren't finished (pages {{pages}}).
agentChat.SLIDES_DONE_HINT: All done. Tell me what to change — e.g. "make the title smaller" or "swap the image on page 3".
agentChat.SLIDES_DRAFT_HINT: Edit the content draft (one section = one page), then come back to confirm.
agentChat.SLIDES_ERROR_AGENTS_UNAVAILABL: The layout agents are temporarily at capacity. Finished pages are kept — retry in a moment to continue.
agentChat.SLIDES_ERROR_LAYOUT_APPLY: Page layout failed completely. Your content draft is safe — you can retry.
agentChat.SLIDES_ERROR_LAYOUT_TAIL: Something went wrong while finishing the layout. You can retry.
agentChat.SLIDES_ERROR_OFFICE_GENERATION: The deck couldn't be saved as a file. You can retry.
agentChat.SLIDES_ERROR_PAGE_IMAGES: Image generation failed. You can skip images and build the pages.
agentChat.SLIDES_ERROR_SESSION_EXPIRED: This generation session expired. Please start again.
agentChat.SLIDES_ERROR_STAGE_CONFLICT: This step already finished; no need to repeat it.
agentChat.SLIDES_ERROR_STORYBOARD_UNAVAI: The storyboard step couldn't get a slot and layout never started. Retry in a moment to continue.
agentChat.SLIDES_IMAGES_ACCEPT_DISPLAY: Keep these images and build the pages
agentChat.SLIDES_IMAGES_ACCEPT_PROMPT: Images confirmed. Use slides_draft(task=generate, draftDocumentId="{{documentId}}", pageImagesDecision="accept") to build the pages.
agentChat.SLIDES_IMAGES_ALL_DROP: Use no images — build the pages
agentChat.SLIDES_IMAGES_ALL_DROP_DISPLAY: No images at all — build the pages
agentChat.SLIDES_IMAGES_ALL_DROP_HINT: Generated images will be discarded and pages will fall back to text-only layouts. Continue?
agentChat.SLIDES_IMAGES_APPLY_PROMPT: Use slides_draft(task=generate, draftDocumentId="{{documentId}}"{{rejects}}{{regenerates}}{{restores}}) to apply my image changes, then continue building the pages.
agentChat.SLIDES_IMAGES_CONFIRM_HINT: Generating images takes a little longer. You can also skip images and build text-only pages.
agentChat.SLIDES_IMAGES_DROP_LABEL: Don't use the image on page {{page}} of "{{title}}"
agentChat.SLIDES_IMAGES_GENERATE_PROMPT: Use slides_draft(task=generate, draftDocumentId="{{documentId}}", pageImagesDecision="generate") to generate body images for "{{title}}".
agentChat.SLIDES_IMAGES_KEEP_LABEL: Keep the image on page {{page}} of "{{title}}"
agentChat.SLIDES_IMAGES_REPLACE_LABEL: Replace the image on page {{page}} of "{{title}}"
agentChat.SLIDES_IMAGES_REVIEW_HINT: Decide keep-or-drop for each image, then submit once.
agentChat.SLIDES_IMAGES_SKIP_PROMPT: Use slides_draft(task=generate, draftDocumentId="{{documentId}}", pageImagesDecision="skip") to skip images and build the pages.
agentChat.SLIDES_INTERRUPTED_HINT: The last run was interrupted. {{done}} / {{total}} finished pages are kept; say "continue the last deck" to resume.
agentChat.SLIDES_IN_PROGRESS_HINT: This step takes a moment. You can switch away — we'll notify you when it's done.
agentChat.SLIDES_OPEN_FAILED: Couldn't open it. Try again from the artifact library.
agentChat.SLIDES_PARTIAL_HINT: {{done}} / {{total}} pages finished; you can generate the rest.
agentChat.SLIDES_PHASE_DRAFTING: Gathering context and drafting the content
agentChat.SLIDES_RETRY_DISPLAY: Try again — continue the last deck
agentChat.SLIDES_RETRY_HINT: To continue, say "continue the last deck".
agentChat.SLIDES_RETRY_PROMPT: The previous deck generation didn't finish ({{reason}}). Continue the last deck from where it failed.
agentChat.SLIDES_STOPPED_HINT: Generation stopped. {{done}} / {{total}} finished pages are kept; say "continue the last deck" to resume.
agentChat.SLIDES_STYLE_CARD_HINT: Once you build with this style, the whole deck will follow it.
agentChat.SLIDES_STYLE_CONFIRM_PROMPT: Style confirmed. Use slides_draft(task=generate, styleSessionId="{{sessionId}}") to generate the deck.
agentChat.SLIDES_STYLE_PICK_HINT: Flip through the large previews and pick the one that feels most like what you want.
agentChat.SLIDES_STYLE_PICK_PROMPT: I pick style {{index}}. Use slides_draft(task=style_select, styleSessionId="{{sessionId}}", candidateIndex={{index}}) to extract the style and produce the style card.
agentChat.SLIDES_STYLE_REGENERATE: None of these — show another set
agentChat.SLIDES_STYLE_REGENERATE_DISPLA: None of these styles work — show another set
agentChat.SLIDES_STYLE_REGENERATE_PROMPT: Use slides_draft(task=style, draftDocumentId="{{documentId}}", regenerate=true, instruction="The user isn't happy with the previous style samples; show another set")
The user isn't happy with the previous style samples; show another set of styles.
agentChat.SLIDES_DRAFT_ARCHIVED: The content draft was archived; you can restore it from the Materials panel.
agentConnections.loadTimeout: Load timed out: gateway not responding. Use the refresh button; if it persists, restart the app.
